scope: Eight pinned repository snapshots, Batch 1 review of 18 active changed paths, fresh local baseline tests, requirements reconciliation, prior GitHub search records, and authorized read-only observation of one Hetzner host. No deployment, push, canonical genesis, or mainnet launch. Missing means not established within this evidence scope. Batch 2 adds five specification drafts, official consensus candidate source review, three source documentation corrections, repair mapping and offline input validation. No runtime or server changes. Batch 3 implements five source-file changes and records a fresh full local workspace run with three resolved failures and 11 open failures. No deployment or release qualification. Batch 4 implements incremental queue admission and corrects measurement validity. Optimized timing passes; 11 default-profile failures remain. No production qualification. Batch 5 repairs four governance failures and retains one policy-dependent failure. The full default workspace has seven failures. No production qualification. The approved Batch 5 eligibility follow-up completes five local governance repairs. Six default failures remain; no production qualification. Batch 6 implements four approved items as components. Production reward integration remains open; three default failures remain. The subsequent approved Batch 6 integration follow-up measures small-stake rounding and implements an explicit development reward adapter. Final workspace: 893 passed, 3 failed, 2 ignored, with no new failures. Original legacy staking source and test remain unchanged. Production finality and epoch-to-block issuance remain undefined or unqualified. Claim recovery follow-up adds signed claim recovery checks and prepared adaptive journal writes. No economic rule or minting is added. The approved issuance timing follow-up now integrates explicit epoch budgets and observations with atomic development block settlement. Workspace: 928 passed, 3 failed, 2 ignored. Production activation remains disabled. Batch 7 integrates the pinned CometBFT candidate for local qualification. Four-validator agreement, quorum loss and recovery checks pass. Workspace: 950 passed, 3 failed, 2 ignored. No new failures or production qualification. Batch 8 implements all seven approved validator lifecycle rules for local qualification. Permissioned admission, exact voting power, H+2 changes, key rotation and owner custody pass local tests. Production withdrawal, operators, numerical values and qualification remain open. Batch 9 adds a checked local penalty and withdrawal profile. Synthetic accounting tests and a zero-evidence network baseline do not qualify production fault processing or withdrawals. Batch 10 locally closes durable receipt filtering during admission and proposal selection. Production queue qualification, full evidence coverage and economic policy remain open.
